$comment: The contract every canonical agent definition must satisfy. Validated by
CTest and reads this file rather than hard-coding the rules -- a schema
the checker ignores is a schema nobody maintains.
Deliberately not JSON Schema: the checker is stdlib-only, because it runs
as a repository gate on three CI platforms and no other tool under tools/
takes a third-party dependency. This is the subset the checker enforces,
written so a reader can see exactly what is required.

name.description: Stable identifier. Renaming one breaks every reference to it.

description.description: What the agent is for, in the third person. This is the text a model reads when deciding whether to delegate, so it states the trigger, not just the topic.

description: Deliberately not an enumeration. The set of colours a platform accepts
is the platform's to define, and the first draft of this schema listed
merged into `sacm-researcher`), whose `brown` had been shipping since #198.
A gate encoding a guess fails on working data and teaches people to edit it.

This field exists because it is the one that drifted. The conformance
verifier's Claude copy said 'you have no write or edit tools' while its
Codex copy said 'you must not create, edit, move, or delete any file' --
a mechanical fact on one platform and a request on the other, for the
role whose entire value is that it cannot fix what it judges.
The tools the agent may use, as a comma-separated list, or `all`.

writes_rationale.description: Why this agent is denied writes. Required only for the restriction, because an unexplained restriction is the one that gets relaxed by the next person who finds it inconvenient.

adapters.description: Which platform adapters to generate. Every entry must be a platform declared in manifest.json.

body.description: The agent prompt, in Markdown, below the frontmatter. Carried into every adapter verbatim.
